system.description:
You perform a swift series of powerful and accurate strikes with both weapons. Before finishing by striking with both weapons simultaneously.

Make two melee taijutsu attacks, with either weapon, dealing your [Weapons damage] + 1d10. If both attacks were successful, you attack one additional time dealing 3d10.

Chain 2: Affected creature(s) must make a Constitution saving throw, becoming Bruised for each successful attack on a failed save or half as many on a successful save.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage of the initial two attacks by 1d10.
